description: 8 code-comprehension traces — predict the exact output. The strongest signal that a model actually understands code, not just pattern-matches keywords.

questions.question: What does [1, 2, 3, 4].reduce((a, b) => a + b * b, 0) evaluate to? Answer with ONLY the number.

function f(n){ return n <= 1 ? 1 : n * f(n - 1); }
What does f(5) return? Answer with ONLY the number.

const r = [1, 2, 3].map(x => x * 2).filter(x => x > 2);
What is r.length? Answer with ONLY the number.
What does (0 || '' || null || 5 || 9) evaluate to? Answer with ONLY the number.

metadata.author: luak-coding-suite
metadata.diagnostic_purpose: Tests whether a model truly understands code by tracing execution and predicting exact output — closures, references, recursion, array methods, spread, the var/let loop trap, and short-circuit evaluation. Output-prediction can't be keyword-gamed, so it is a strong discriminator of real coding ability (feeds ikbi model selection).

known_scoring_limitations: Numeric-answer matching; a model that reasons correctly but formats the number unusually could be marked wrong (max_chars keeps answers terse).
